notes.title: Version 1.0.2.4 - Improved performance and character control
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/e581cd240ed7ae866cc41cf6098fa817e12f39f0.png[/img]

Hallo Ellarians,

We just uploaded a new version with major overall performance improvement, reduced loading time between map travel, and a better character movement and jumping.

One of our biggest changes was to reduce the impact of having a large number of characters in the same place. We introduced a new system that changes the character resolution dynamically based on their clothing and complexity, and their distance from the camera. This system reduces the character performance issues by 80% and [b]increases the frame rate by as much as 15 extra frames per second.[/b]

In addition, we went over thousands of textures and items optimized them. This optimizations [b]increases the game performance by 25%-50%, the required memory by 25%, and the loading time between maps by as much as 30%. [/b]

As a result of these changes, you should notice a significant improvement to LoE performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/70782c0348bbc563b8f890f7416f5622e8d9079d.jpg[/img]

Another improvement that we've made is to the character movement and jumping, as well as the camera following the player. These changes makes sure that you will have a more intuitive and smoother movement and jumping, without changing too much of the character stats.

Our next goal is to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/621070/announcements/detail/3612480255012641486]improve the story line and quests[/url], In the meanwhile, We wish to thank you for your feedback. We will continue to optimize and improve other parts of LoE as much as we can.

[b]Version 1.0.2.4 Changes[/b] [i](7/2/23)[/i]
[list]
[*] Reduced NPC performance cost by 50% near the camera
[*] Reduced NPC performance cost by up to 90% when far away from camera
[*] Multiple texture and model reduction, by up to 75% of the original size without losing graphics
[*] Increased overall graphic performance by up to 50% (depending on the region)
[*] Reduced the size of the game and memory (RAM) by 25%
[*] Reduced game loading time between regions by up to 30% (depending on the region)
[*] Improved character movement and jumping
[*] Improved camera following the player in third person
[/list]

notes.title: New milestones and planned major changes.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/e9826197ed08d93a713f826e4de6faed56ce1258.png[/img]

Dear Ellarians.

We've made new features and important fixes in the last year, and now it's time to focus on old features. We're going to improve and remaster important parts of Legends of Ellaria.

Since we're more than an year after the full release, we're going to be creative and change core game elements, such as the character movement and loading screen. We've read your feedbacks and feel that these elements would be more important for you than adding a new feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/70782c0348bbc563b8f890f7416f5622e8d9079d.jpg[/img]

[b]So, we're going to work on the following things[/b]

[b]1: Player Controller[/b]
[list]
[*]Player Movement feeling(speed, animations e.t.c).
[*]Player Combat moves and feeling.
[/list]
[b]2: RPG - Combat[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix Skills/Abilities based on your feedbacks.
[*]Rebalance The Skill Tree and bonuses.
[/list]
[b]3: Loading Screens[/b]
[list]
[*]Remove the loading screens whenever possible.
[*]Decrease loading screen times.
[*]Make a more immersive loading screen.
[/list]
[b]4: Performance[/b]
[list]
[*]Improve Framerate.
[*]Reduce system requirements.
[/list]
[b]5: Tutorial:[/b]
[list]
[*]Mara (Chapter 0) will remain as it is, but will be converted to a mission instead of a game tutorial
[*]Tutorial will start from Chapter 1, and will help the player to get familiar with the game
[/list]
[b]6: Missions:[/b]
[list]
[*]Some missions will be rebuilt to improve the game lowness and to work better with a new tutorial.
[*]Improve repeating missions and unnecessarily long missions.
[/list]
[b]7: RTS Combat:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix AI Behavior.
[*]Fix AI response to the player tactics.
[/list]
[b]8: Graphics:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improve general graphics.
[*]Add some missing graphics and effects.
[/list]
[b]9: UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjust the User Interface to be more fluent.
[/list]
[b]10: Inventory System[/b]
[list]
[*] Improve and balance inventory system.
[/list]

This is a long list and we can't promise to change all of the above. We also can't tell you how long these changes will take. In the meanwhile, we would appreciate any suggestion as we want to focus on the most important things to change.  We're available for any question and suggestion in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/H9hYev8]discord channel.[/url]

notes.title: Six months since release, added new graphics and a discount
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/e3cd721d3012ca0e712ea9ce29275725ebe490f1.png[/img]

Hallo Ellarians,

Today, we are celebrating six months since Legends of Ellaria was released. Thanks to you, we've made many changes during that time, both in visuals and game tweaks.

We've also added new graphics in today's version and a special discount on our store page to celebrate this occasion.

We want to thank everyone who gave us feedback. Even after its release, you've helped us polish, balance, and add essential parts to Legends of Ellaria. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/2b529c66629c04b1c9aab534840fb8e3e62cee8b.gif[/img]



[b]In the past six months, we've changed the following[/b]:
[list]

[*] Made major optimizations to the game.

[*] Improved graphics, lighting and atmosphere.

[*] Improved, fixed and tweaked the user interface.

[*] Balanced and tweaked the Druid class to be an unstoppable support class.

[*] Balanced and tweaked the Rift Mage as a multi role mage, able to teleport easier, use guided projectiles and versatile spells. Also, the Rift mage now has the largest maximum mana stat skill points from all mage classes.

[*] Balanced and tweaked the elemental mage class to deliver more raw damage per spell. 

[*] Balanced and tweaked the ranger class to have more accuracy at earlier levels, draw arrows faster, deliver more damage and consume less stamina per shot. The ranger class is most dangerous in higher levels, especially when supported by your soldiers.

[*] Balanced and tweaked kingdom management to allow you to build larger kingdoms and use strategic locations. Multiple buildings stats and kingdom management cap penalty were changed based on community requests and rebalancing.

[*] Tweaked the Kingdom research tree to give more versatility to economics and management tree.

[*] Balanced and tweaked weaker military units, such as militia, to allow for an easier start and an easier kingdom defense through your progress.

[*] Added a "Demolish" button to city construction

[*] Improved "Defense Bonus" logic to city and world constructions.

[*] Chapter I is unlocked even if you didn't finish the tutorial.

[*] Made multiple changes to the tutorial.

[*] Changed and tweaked multiple quests and dialogues.

[*] Improved the AI and path finding.

[*] Fixed bugs and added multiple changes based on your suggestions.
[/list]

[b]In today's version 1.0.1.15 [i](10/14/21)[/i] we changed the following:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added melee effect and sound.
[*] Added hit effect and blood effect for melee attacks.
[*] Reduced the number of combat shouts for the player during melee attacks.
[*] Changed bow holster location to fit the back in a more natural way.
[*] Bow does not automatically shoot when you run out of stamina.
[*] Increased low stamina arrow speed from 10% to 75%.
[*] Reduced base bow stamina cost from 6 to 4 for short bow.
[*] Reduced base bow stamina cost from 7 to 5 for composite bow.
[*] Reduced base bow stamina cost from 10 to 7 for long bow.
[*] Increased Outpost Defense Bonus from 20 to 50.
[/list]

And again, we wish to thank you for your feedback. We will continue to fix and tweak any issue we'll find and balance and add things by your suggestion. 

[b]In future versions, we will[/b]:

[list]
[*] Continue to balance kingdom and combat
[*] Continue to optimize Legends of Ellaria
[*] Fix bugs and add tweaks based on your suggestion
[*] Add the Necromancer class
[/list]

Please continue to play and send us any issues you encounter, and we will address those issues.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1.11 - Combat Classes Balancing
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/e9826197ed08d93a713f826e4de6faed56ce1258.png[/img]

Hallo Ellarians,

We just uploaded a new version with major balancing to combat damages and stats and a few minor fixes to dialogues and combat mechanics.

We took some of your suggestions and made some extensive tests to make sure that all the player classes are balanced. Some of the classes were weaker than others, and some, like the mage class, were strong at the beginning but would not scale properly as you level up.

Our biggest change was to the ranger class, as we've significantly increased the damage and accuracy at lower levels. We've made sure that the ranger class will be much deadlier and that you won't have to be level 15 or above to gain high bow accuracy

In addition, we fixed a persistent fire enchantment effect that would stay after the effect was done. We also made sure that the player will be able to remove the fire enchantment effect by casting the "Minor Dispel." We also fixed several issues with the merchant guild dialogues.

We wish to thank you for your feedback. We will continue to fix and tweak any issue we'll find and balance and add things by your suggestion. Also, stay tuned for the Necromancer DLC.

notes.title: Upcoming Major Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/d1c50aa44c58f9e64c1c078331ad2cd345a1dba4.jpg[/img]

[i][b]The wind howls, and there are strange whispers in the dark. The sound of soft footsteps come from empty, long forsaken rooms. Around a crackling fire, the elders tell stories of old – stories of hags and warlocks, wicked tricksters and evil spirits. Halloween is here, and the spooky season comes to Ellaria too! [/b][/i]

It’s been some time since our last update; we’ve been hard at work developing new content for the game, and we’re really excited to share with you some details about the next update of Legends of Ellaria. This will be one of the biggest updates in a long long time, so buckle up to check what’s coming to your kingdom! 

[b]New locations to explore [/b]

Ellaria will be even bigger with new maps and locations to explore, with miles of terrain full of new dangers – and rewards for those brave enough to face these challenges. A multitude of new dungeons, caves, camps and villages will be added to the world map. Each new map is 2 in-game miles wide – about 8 times bigger than they were before, and with more things to do than ever! 

[b]New quests and events[/b]

We hope you have not stashed your weapon of choice too far if you felt at some point you were running out of adventures, we’re adding more than one hundred quests and events for you to experience, as well as new items to search! These quests may not only help you to level up your character, but also to affect your kingdom as a whole. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/5949924da5cad6c0c500d7a57fda169a7faa3d1f.jpg[/img]

[b]A new kingdom…[/b]

In the last months we’ve discussed how kingdom management was shaping up – you can read our dev diaries about it here and here. Finally, these features are coming to the game! Mine for resources, construct buildings in your cities (more than 20 new buildings added!) and research technologies to upgrade them, keep your army morale up and win battles to expand your borders.  

[b]…and new ways to rule it [/b]

You can be a ruler with an iron fist, expanding your kingdom through war and conquest, or an adventurer king who goes on special quests. You can hire mercenaries or improve your economy to keep a strong standing army. Real-time strategy battles have been revamped for a better strategic experience. There are many different approaches to governing – follow your heart and instincts to become the most powerful ruler of Ellaria! 

[b]Take detours[/b]

Ruling and going on adventures are just two of the many things you can do in Ellaria. Help your settlers working in the farmlands or mining for resources, talk to them to hear their personal stories, collect Artifacts for the librarian… even the new loading screen has minigames!

[b]That’s is the tip of the iceberg[/b]: just about every feature of the game has received some kind of improvement, a huge step closer in our road towards full release. If all this sounds interesting… we have to say that it is only the beginning, for there is something even bigger coming to Legends of Ellaria: finally, the campaign main story is coming to the game! A story of heroes and villains, politics and intrigues, with many different characters, quests and epic battles, the main story spans through five chapters with multiple choices and side optional missions. In this next major update we’re releasing the first chapter of the main story – but that’s all we can tell you for now. We’ll give you more details about this in a few days, so stay tuned!

It’s been a while since our last announcement, so first of all, we want to send our best wishes to you and your loved ones in these challenging times. We hope you are doing as good as possible under the circumstances. Stay safe, stay strong – we’ll get through this together!  

That said, we’ve got great news to share. Although the coronavirus crisis has shaken our world as much as everyone’s, we are a small team, and thankfully we could adapt quickly to remote working. Thus, our development hasn’t been too badly affected by this situation… and we are ready to announce that our game is in the last leg of its development. After several years in Early Access, Legends of Ellaria will launch its full release version in middle Q3!

This announcement comes with a warning, though. As we explained in the Early Access FAQ, our plan was always to increase the price of the game as the game grew. Now that we’re close to full release, that time has come: the game is now bigger and better in every sense that when we launched in Early Access. Starting on May 7th, the price will be increased to 24.99$.
 
This is also a way to thank our Early Access supporters that have got us this far, so those who believed in us since the beginning end up paying less as a token of appreciation for their trust. You still have a few days with the Early Access price, though, so if you were on the fence on buying Legends of Ellaria, go jump at it now before the increase!

In the coming days and weeks, we will share more information about the full version of the game and its release. If you want to stay up to date, hit the Follow button, and Wishlist the game. 

See you in Ellaria, adventurers!

notes.title: Optimizations And Tweaks Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/36fd4ccfe46421eb4e649f14b15719dd1723987e.gif[/img]

Dear Legends of Ellaria players,

In the past few weeks, we've made important optimizations to our game engine, as well as tweaks and fixes from discussions and bug reports.

These changes are a part of a long-awaited expansion of our gameplay engine, which will allow us to integrate the new quest systems and remaining features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/765298e690996aa33dae07dd2f67609283e6c4cb.jpg[/img]

The first thing we focused on was to reduce texture and memory size. For that end, we've implemented a new system that loads textures in memory depending on where you are.

Another thing we've fixed is the pathfinding and movement logics. The citizens were colliding with some objects on their way to places, and enemies were jumping on top of each other when fighting in large formations. We've fixed these issues and also fixed followers and movement issues in small spaces. 

As a bonus, we've also improved the combat animations and tweaked some elements of the combat, both for small and large battles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29507675/fae007d031f98c11979ebc87e1bacabb3c6b5b5b.gif[/img]

In addition, we've changed much of our sky rendering, which improved the speed and also shows better clouds and skies.

Its been a busy month, as we went over multiple areas of LoE and reduced multiple overloads that were causing sudden frame rate drops, such as in combat or in cities. We also collected bug reports and fixed multiple bugs in management, logics, graphics and more. We'll continue to improve LoE as we go. Thank you for your help and for all the bug reports!

notes.title: RPG Progress Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29507675/4e5bcaa5ea0fa89c012db04f38e7aad735c6fa24.jpg[/img]

Dear community, 

We've made much progress towards the upcoming RPG system version as we have now finished the framework for both the graphical and the logical aspects of the general RPG & leveling system. 

With that in mind, we rewrote the player controls to support special moves, such as whirlwind or blink. This new system includes a whole new state machine for the animation controller.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29507675/d9d171dd4e24bb3a712dc89e89ae7257794f0381.png[/img]

We're also rewriting our whole graphical interface, which will include a new HUD, a full-screen inventory, and several new windows for the RPG system. 

The RPG user interface will include the tech tree for the skills, which will also be used for the city tech tree in the world update.

notes.notes:

Dear community,

The second major update for Legends of Ellaria is here! 

[b]After many suggestions, feedback, reviews, private messages, emails, dev talks, and beta testing, we decided to prioritize on the critical issues many of you were having.

You will now be able to enjoy: [/b]
[list]
[*] Overhauled graphics and effects, including better texture display, lighting, shadows and colors.
[*] Reduced initial RAM usage by over 50%. The game should now load faster and use less memory overall.
[*] Outdoor objects now getting wet when it rains.
[*] A second floor to the player's home, which includes more chests and props.
[*] A "sleep" feature for your king, accessible through the player’s home.
[*] A more challenging melee combat system.
[*] Smarter civilian NPCs that now use roads whenever possible.
[*] Player walks faster.
[*] Soldiers following you into dungeons when they are in follow state; Otherwise, they will perform the command you have given them.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29507675/fc8f21885ca473626eec7831cc71eff2aef91aaa.jpg[/img]

[b]As well as the following fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Barracks door for old saves
[*] Fixed the Blacksmith door for old saves
[*] Fixed some fog and tree issues for the dark forest
[*] Fixed some pathfinding issues for the civilians and soldiers
[*] Fixed civilian animations in certain places
[*] Enemies don't get knocked through walls anymore
[*] Fixed an issue where civilians had more than one tool in their hands
[*] Fixed an issue where civilians were walking irregularly while carrying wood
[*] Fixed an issue where civilians did work and construction misplacements
[/list]

[b]Notes from the Part 1:
Completely overhauled the construction:[/b]
[list]
[*]When placing a building: Buildings check if they can be constructed by their shape and not by a general distance from other buildings
[*]When placing a building: Buildings cannot be built inside a mountain or close to a cliff - which removes bugs related to doors inside mountains or buildings in the air
[*]When constructing a new building, the terrain gets flat exactly where it should, and not as a general circle around the building.
[*]Buildings snap to the terrain by their entrance and not by their center. The front entrance is always linked to the terrain smoothly
[*]To compensate for the new system, old saves will try to snap the buildings into a more manageable position. If you encounter any problem with old saves, please send us your save file and we will fix it.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29507675/223948169809b709be6c7a08a4c3c204c5f13013.jpg[/img]

[b]Completely Overhauled the Weather and Sky:[/b]
[list]
[*]Included a new cloud system that looks more natural and full
[*]Improved the weather and sky’s performance
[*]Rain is more epic, and storms are darker at night
[*]Night time lighting and sky is smoother
[/list]

[b]Graphics improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Included a new grass system which looks better and has touch - bending features
[*]Improved some of the terrain’s textures
[*]Most objects in the game react to rain and wetness, more to come
[*]Improved 25% of the texture and memory usage, much more to come
[*]Improved Camera effects and general game atmosphere, more to come
[*]Temporarily removed VSync, which will be added to the options menu in later versions
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29507675/d4857ee51029141bbb7412645c0fe19661307eda.jpg[/img]

[b]Made General Fixes and improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]When Pressing "New Game" and then pressing the Escape button, the game doesn't start a new game
[*]When falling through the ground or from the edge of the world, your character will be returned to a normal position
[*]Fixed an issue where the terrain would be flat or have flat portions
[/list]

[b]Improved AI:[/b]
[list]
[*]Enemies try to avoid the Circle of Fire spell whenever possible
[*]Completely rebuild the Pathfinder system; NPC goes smoother and smarter from place to place.
[*]Improved Followers and RTS Commands:
[*]Followers can now follow you indoors. When you enter a dungeon, 3 of your best soldiers will go in with you.
[*]Followers won’t wander too far from you unless instructed to. When in combat, followers will disengage and return to you in a tactical way if you are too far from them. 
[*]Also, when pressing the ‘Follow’ command during combat, soldiers will immediately disengage and retreat towards you
[*]Soldiers react to Attack, Move and Follow commands even when in combat mode
[/list]


[b]As of now, we are beginning to work on much-anticipated features such as a full RPG system, an initial RTS experience, and 'The Sphere of Influence' (more news on that later). 

In the near future, updates will include: [/b]
[list]
[*]Full RPG Leveling System
[*]World Map
[*]Siege Weapons
[*]Destructible buildings and castle wars
[*]Mage Towers
[*]Kingdom Management
[*]Cavalry and much, much more
[/list]

We can't be more thankful and humbled by your support until now, we will continue to work non-stop to bring you an epic title, so please continue to give us ideas and suggestions on how to improve.

We are here to build the best game possible, so as long as you tell us where is the issue, we will be there to fix it. 

Thank you for joining us in Legends of Ellaria, there is still much, much more to come.

Sincerely, 

- The Larkon Studio Team

notes.title: Major Update #2 and Beta Dev Progress
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29507675/f9dfbbcf63a9add97a3eaa6ac5053e7338d9c0df.jpg[/img]
You will now be able to take your army inside for a dungeon raid!

[b]Development Progress:[/b]

Dear community, we have been reviewing all of your feedback through the Steam discussions, reviews, and our Discord server. We wanted to take the time to tell you a little more about our development schedule, and why we decided to work on the optimizations that we have instead of building upon new features for this update. 

We read every single one of your reviews, comments, feedback, suggestions, and even rants, furthermore we also take action based on them. Some of you are having critical issues with game crashes, bugs, and slow performance with the game, so instead of adding more cool stuff into it, we thought it would be best to first polish what we have built until now. 

This is also why next week we will finally open our Beta for which some of you have been registered to (In case you haven't and wish to join, write us here or DM via the Steam profile). 

[b]The beta version will include the following: [/b]
1: reduced usage of virtual memory, which is the main cause of the game crashes as well as the player appearing under the ground bug. 
2: new and a better-optimized weather system which increases FPS as well.
3: Some new and better-performing camera effects.
4: New and much less CPU consuming pathfinder system. 
5: New army formations in RTS mode, the soldiers will now follow you on formation when possible, and will gather near you in tight places.
6: Soldiers in your army will now go with you inside dungeons.

Within the Beta, you will test all these features, and we will prepare for our second major update this February 15, which will include: 

1: All the above + further FPS increase as well as a new and better-performing environment system.
2: A fixed citizens algorithm, correcting misc. bugs that make them act unpredictably (and in some cases, in a funny/buggy way).
3: Groups in RTS mode, you will be able to select soldiers and add them to groups and command groups using hotkeys.
4: Better combat AI, NPCs will avoid the circle of fire and others dangers, and they will be more aggressive and smarter when in combat mode.

Basically, with your help, we will have a much better-performing game, which will then help us build tons of new features that you have all been asking.


[b]A short debrief of what to expect after the 15\2 version:[/b]

A week or 2 after, we will finally release new quests and maps, followed by implementing a full RPG Leveling system, a sphere of Influence with the world map(by April), the Market, Destructible walls and finally, a multiplayer experience (by Summer). For more details please check our [url=http://www.larkonstudio.com/RoadMap.jpg]Development Road Map[/url]

If you have any other ideas or suggestions, please let us know through a [url=http://store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/621070]Steam review[/url], your review helps us a lot and are we deeply appreciate your opinion.



See you in Ellaria, 

Larkon Studio

notes.title: Version 0.5.38.8 - Bug fixes, Key binding and character movement
notes.notes:
Version 0.5.38.8 is now Live with some of the bug fixes and features you have been asking us! 

We want to say thank you to all of you that have been leaving reviews and giving us feedback through our different channels; we're working hard on improving the bug reports you have sent as well the suggestions you've mentioned. 

This new version includes a basic Key Binding and a smoother movement control for your character. We've also fixed some important issues with Legends of Ellaria by your request.

[b]New Features:[/b]

[list]
[*]Your character has a smoother control. There is no delay between pressing the movement control and the character moves towards the direction you have set without a slow rotation.
[*]Character has a "Default Walk or Run" (Set by Caps Lock), both for combat and casual mode
[*]Key binding (still missing several commands, including the WASD. We will add them soon)
[*] Game configuration and saves now exist in : [i]C:\Users\[USER]\AppData\LocalLow\Larkon Studio\Legends of Ellaria[/i]
[/list]

[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
[list]

[*]Fixed an issue where LoE is stuck in "Game is Loading." 
[*]Fixed more issues with permission to "My Documents." 
[*]May have fixed the spinning camera issue with for people who own a Joystick. See [i]"Known Issues"[/i]
[/list]

[b]Known issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]Can't change the movement (WASD) keys binding
[*] When helping to construct a building, the building is not constructed and the game has issues with saving and loading
[*]Not all Joysticks and Gamepads were tested for the spinning camera bug. Some Joystick owners may experience an issue where the camera is constantly rotating around them. If you have this issue, please send us a report or email with your Joystick / Gamepad model information.

See you In Ellaria, 

Larkon Studio

notes.notes:

[*]The minimap circle was blocking the help (F1 key) display
[*]Quest stages were updated in the wrong locations

[*]You can delete unwanted saves in the load window.
